_supertrend_proxy_note: The background SuperTrend calc (scripts/supertrend-monitor.js, scripts/signal-grid.js) pulls candles from Bitstamp's public API, which doesn't list Coinbase Derivatives futures. Each watchlist symbol maps to its nearest liquid Bitstamp spot pair as a close-tracking proxy -- not the exact instrument.

bullish: Price is above the 20 EMA on the 4H
bearish: Price is below the 20 EMA on the 4H
neutral: Price is chopping around the 20 EMA

risk_rules: Only take trades where R:R is at least 1:2
No trading in the first 15 minutes of the NY session open
If I have 2 losing trades in a row, stop for the day
notes: Add any other context you want Claude to factor in — e.g. macro events this week, key dates, anything that should affect your bias.
